alkylation reagent: the gel cubes were alkylated in 50 mM iodoacetamide/50 mM ABC
alkylation concentration: the gel cubes were alkylated in 50 mM iodoacetamide/50 mM ABC
cleavage agent: covered with trypsin solution (Promega, 6.25 ng/ml in 50 mM ABC)
collision energy: the HCD (higher-energy collision) cell (1.6 amu isolation width, 25% normalized collision energy)
fractionation method: based on label-free nanoLC-MS/MS of gel-fractionated proteins
fragmentation method: submitted to MS/MS in the HCD (higher-energy collision) cell
instrument: ionized at a potential of +2 kVa into a Q Exactive mass spectrometer
labeling: based on label-free nanoLC-MS/MS of gel-fractionated proteins
reduction reagent: the gel cubes were reduced in 10 mM DTT/50 mM ABC
reduction concentration: the gel cubes were reduced in 10 mM DTT/50 mM ABC
